title: Ornament Painting
seo_title: Free Family Ornament Painting at McCoy's in Joplin
description: Kids can decorate a wooden ornament for the tree at this free, family-friendly ornament painting event, and toys will be collected for the Holiday Toy Drive. It is free while supplies last, and no registration is required. It runs Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM at all McCoy's locations, including 205 S McCoy Ave in Joplin, MO.
address: 205 S McCoy Ave, Joplin, MO 64801-3061, United States, Joplin, MO
